proof_body:
by
  intro f a b hab hf h
  have hopen : Set.EqOn f (fun _ => 0) (Set.Ioo a b) := by
    intro x hx
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ t in a..u, f t) (f x) x :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hf.intervalIntegrable _ _) (hf.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hf.continuousAt
    have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun u => ∫ t in a..u, f t) 0 x := by
      refine (hasDerivAt_const x (0 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds hx.1 hx.2] with u hu
      exact h u ⟨hu.1.le, hu.2.le⟩
    exact hd.unique h0
  intro x hx
  have hcl : x ∈ closure (Set.Ioo a b) := by
    rw [closure_Ioo hab.ne]
    exact hx
  exact hopen.closure hf continuous_const hcl
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → Continuous f → (∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∫ t in a..x, f t = 0) → ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x = 0
